name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 8 visits over 31 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 31 hours starting 2026-04-30, at wavelengths from 1.22 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
